messages:
Ayesha (AE): Hey team — POC kickoff with FinCo tomorrow. They require BYO keystore (HSM-backed CMK), monthly rotation policy, and an auditable handshake for cutover. Need: preflight checklist, rough pricing delta vs. standard hosted, and a runbook owner. Who can pick up handshake runbook?
Tom (Solutions Eng): I can take the runbook. Quick clarifying q: do they need attestation documents shipped off-prem to their SIEM or just logs forwarded?
Ayesha (AE): Off-prem attestation + audit events to Splunk. Also they want a 2h cutover window and zero-more-than-15-mins graceful fallback.
Priya (Security): We can forward audit events over HTTPS/syslog. For attestation we require cert exchange + attestation statement from their HSM vendor. Legal needs to review DPA addendum for cust-managed keys. I'll start the secq responses for the RFP.
Marcus (SRE): For cutover planning: recommend a 2h window; failover plan is: key-proxy -> provider-managed key fallback for up to 15m, then degrade to read-only. Need confirmation on RTO/RPO SLAs from customer.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Draft handshake snippet (dev-only):
```
# initiate BYO KMS handshake
rdw-kms handshake --mode byo --endpoint hsm.finco.example:9443 \
  --cert ./finco.crt --key ./finco.key --attest verify
```
Tom (Solutions Eng): Will flesh into full runbook (attestation exchange steps, cert formats, network whitelists, port perms) and post by EOD.
Ayesha (AE): Pricing ask from customer: reserved capacity + surcharge for proxied HSM traffic. Can finance give ballpark?
FinanceBot: Pricing ticket created: P-4321 (https://redwood.example/p/P-4321) — attach required volumes.
Marcus (SRE): Ballpark: add ~20% on top of reserved GPU commit for management overhead + $0.0025–$0.0035 per proxied request depending on TLS session reuse. Exact depends on QPS and caching.
Ayesha (AE): They estimate peak 10k concurrent requests, ~50M tokens/mo. Also asking about rotation cadence — they want 30d but may accept 90d for some keys.
Priya (Security): Rotation: we support automated rotation with custom intervals. If customer wants split-key/escrow during rotation we'll need a key-ceremony page in the SOW and escrow clauses. Q14 in sec questionnaire: "Who controls rotation and can we enforce cust schedule?" Answer: customer-controlled rotation via CMK; Redwood will operate rotation per customer schedule when BYO is enabled.
Ayesha (AE): Noted. I'll update SOW with rotation options and escrow text. Legal please review DPA/KMS addendum.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Network prerequisites: whitelist our proxy IPs, open outbound 9443, mTLS certs installed, and a healthcheck endpoint for attestation status. I'll attach sample nginx/proxy config.
Priya (Security): Security item: we need their HSM vendor attestation format (TPM/TCPA vs PKCS#11 signage). If they use CloudHSM, we need the NSS cert chain.
Marcus (SRE): Ops blockers: customer asked about multi-AZ failover for key proxy. We can support active-passive across AZs but need cross-AZ bandwidth tests. Schedule window for dry-run.
Ayesha (AE): Action items: Tom -> handshake runbook by EOD; Priya -> secq answers + attestation checklist; Marcus -> cutover dry-run plan and bandwidth test slots; Finance -> draft delta pricing by tomorrow AM. I'll coordinate with customer for an initial dry-run on 2026-05-08.
Tom (Solutions Eng): On it.
Priya (Security): I'll post secq answers to the shared doc and DM legal.
Marcus (SRE): I'll block 2026-05-06 for an internal dry-run and 05-08 for customer-FTR.
Ayesha (AE): Great — tagging @Tom, @Priya, @Marcus. :thumbsup:
FinanceBot: Reminder: attach volumes to P-4321 to generate accurate quote.
